metadata.title: The Cloud Who Packed a Picnic
metadata.subtitle: A Little Shade, a Lot to Share
metadata.author: Giggle & Snooze
metadata.blurb: Ollo wants to bring something to a picnic, but pears and cups slip through his fluffy arms. A warm afternoon helps the little cloud discover a gift all his own.
metadata.dedication: For every little one with something lovely to share.

style_bible.style_prompt_prefix: Original Giggle & Snooze character design: expressive asymmetric poses, rounded bean and crescent shapes, warm playful faces, a small visual joke and a calm cosy atmosphere. Clean contemporary shapes, generous breathing room, one clear story action. Simplify hair, clothing and scenery into broad shapes; include only story-relevant props. Contemporary 2D animation shapes, distinctive silhouettes, expressive eyes, smooth colour fills and restrained soft shading.

characters.name: Ollo
characters.look: Ollo is a small cream cloud with three rounded top lobes, a single curled forelock, two short puffy arms and no legs. Ollo has two dark oval eyes, coral cheeks and an expressive curved mouth.

characters.name: Zadie
characters.look: Zadie is a small child with warm brown skin and dark hair shaped into two rounded puff buns. She wears coral dungarees over a cream T-shirt and teal shoes, with a yellow crescent patch on one pocket.

characters.name: Tavi
characters.look: Tavi is a tiny teal tortoise with a smooth butter-yellow domed shell and four stubby legs. Tavi has two dark oval eyes and one simple crescent marking on the shell, with no clothing.

pages.title: An Invitation
pages.text: Zadie spread a picnic blanket on the hill. Tavi brought a pear. Ollo floated down to see. "Come and share!" called Zadie.
pages.prompt: Zadie kneels beside a plain coral picnic blanket on one curved grassy hill; Tavi nudges a single pear onto it. Ollo floats close above them with a curious tilt; open cream-blue sky and only one distant hill.

pages.title: A Slippery Pear
pages.text: Ollo reached for the pear. It slipped through his fluffy arms. Tavi stopped it with his nose. "A rolling picnic!" said Zadie.
pages.prompt: Ollo cups his puffy arms with a surprised face while the single pear rests safely beside Tavi's nose directly below. Zadie leans sideways laughing gently; the same coral blanket anchors the scene, no extra props.

pages.title: A Cup of Nothing
pages.text: Ollo tried a little cup. That slipped through, too. Zadie picked it up. Ollo's fluffy shoulders drooped.
pages.prompt: Zadie lifts one small empty teal cup from the blanket; Ollo floats beside her with drooping puffy arms and a small disappointed mouth. Tavi looks kindly upward; keep the pear on the blanket and the background very simple.

pages.title: Too Warm
pages.text: The sun warmed the hill. Zadie fanned her face. Tavi tucked his head into his shell. Ollo drifted closer.
pages.prompt: Zadie sits on the coral blanket shading her warm face with one hand. Tavi's head peeks partly inside his yellow shell; Ollo approaches from the upper left. A simple sun and pale open sky establish warmth without dramatic rays.

pages.title: A Cool Surprise
pages.text: A cool patch followed Ollo across the blanket. Zadie pointed to it. Tavi peeked out. "Your shade could keep us cool!" said Zadie.
pages.prompt: Ollo floats directly above the picnic; a broad soft cool shadow lies across the blanket beneath him. Zadie lowers her hand with a relieved smile and Tavi stretches his head out. Make the single shadow and their changed expressions clearly readable.

pages.title: Ollo's Gift
pages.text: Ollo stretched his fluffy arms. His shade reached every corner. "I brought a cool spot!" he said. "Just what we needed," said Zadie.
pages.prompt: Ollo stretches wider overhead with a proud asymmetric grin, keeping the same three lobes and curled forelock. Zadie and Tavi relax fully inside his broad soft shade; the pear and cup remain on the coral blanket. One joyful focal action, no extra decorations.

pages.title: A Place for Everyone
pages.text: They shared the pear and the peaceful hill. Tavi rested beside Zadie. Above them, Ollo curled into a cosy puff. There was a place at the picnic for everyone.
pages.prompt: A calm wide view of the same hill: Zadie rests on the coral blanket beside sleepy Tavi, with two pear pieces and the small cup nearby. Ollo curls his puffy arms inward overhead, smiling with half-closed eyes and still shading his friends; ample quiet sky, no new scenery.
